needed.evidence: No purpose-built footway present on the right side of the road, people seen walking in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous sidewalk along the right side of the street to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No purpose-built footway present on the left side of the road, people potentially must walk in the roadway
needed.suggestion: Introduce a sidewalk on the left side of the street with a physical barrier separating it from the road.

needed.evidence: People are crossing the road without a zebra crossing or other crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install marked zebra crossings at suitable intervals to provide a safe facility for pedestrians to cross the road.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility present despite evidence of pedestrian crossing need
needed.suggestion: Ensure any future crossing facility is well-marked and includes pedestrian signals for improved safety.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting on an urban roadway
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights along the road to improve visibility at night and enhance pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: Poor road surface condition might pose a trip hazard to pedestrians and drivers
needed.suggestion: Repair and level uneven sections of the road surface to prevent tripping hazards for pedestrians and vehicles.
